```{r}
## read-in raw unformatted data 
usa_raw <- read.csv("raw_data/USA_raw.csv")
gbr_raw <- read.csv("raw_data/GBR_raw.csv") 
jpn_raw <- read.csv("raw_data/JPN_raw.csv")
cad_raw <- read.csv("raw_data/CAD_raw.csv")

mats = c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)
fmats = c(1,2,3,6,9,12,24,60,72,84,120,240,360)

start_date <- "2000-01-01"
end_date <- "2000-01-30"

gbr_raw[1479:1500,]
```

```{r}
## validate format 
tmp <- dr_yield_format(gbr_raw, mats=mats, start_date=start_date, end_date=end_date)
```

```{r}
mats <- c(1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 60, 84, 120, 240, 360)
lambdas <- seq(0.01, 0.5, by=0.005)
init_date <- "2000-01-01"
end_date <- "2000-01-30"

## date range selection 
date_seq <- seq.Date(ymd(start_date), ymd(end_date), by = "day")
weekday_seq <- date_seq[weekdays(date_seq) %in% c("Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday")]

asdf <- dr_daily(data=tmp, reference=weekday_seq, threshold = 8)
```

```{r} 
source("data_formatting/dr_formatting.R")
source("core_formatting.R")

j <- dr_build_curve(asdf, c(1,2,3,6,9,12,24,60,72,84,120,240,360), build="spline", spline_method="natural")
j
jk <- dr_build_curve(asdf, c(1,2,3,6,9,12,24,60,72,84,120,240,360),build="parametric", par_method="nelson")
jk
jkl <- dr_build_curve(asdf, c(1,2,3,6,9,12,24,60,72,84,120,240,360), build="log")


lo <- lambda_grid_search(lambdas, jkl[1:20,], fmats)
ph <- bl_phi(lo, fmats)
as <- bl_NSbetas(jkl[1:20,], lo, ph$cross_phi, fmats)
```

```{r}
source("yield_estimation/bl_single_curve.R")

lambdas <- seq(from=0.001, to = 1, length.out=100)
fit_check <- sc_fit(jkl[1:20,], fmats, type="nelson" )
fit_check


qwer <- sc_NSdaily(jkl[1:20,-1], fmats)
dfj <- sc_NSwindow(lo, jkl[1:20, -1], fmats)
qwer$NSyields

sc_test <- sc_fit(yields=jkl[1:20,], mats=fmats, type="nelson", ts=TRUE, 
                  slambdas = c(2,3))

sc_test$dynamic$l3

```
